headline: Huawei Found Guilty of Trade Secrets Theft and Lying to Regulators
summary: A US jury found tech giant Huawei guilty of stealing trade secrets and lying to regulators over its work in Iran, drawing a sharp rebuke from Beijing over suppressing Chinese firms.
why: Huawei is a major global telecommunications and technology equipment manufacturer entangled in trade and security disputes with Western governments.

impacts.name: Huawei Technologies
impacts.why: Criminal convictions increase legal liabilities and restrict international business operations.
